diagnosed: One real, reproducible mechanical breakage, unchanged and still the ONLY outstanding mechanical fault — and its only correct fix lives entirely in a protected path: the research ESCALATION fast-lane is broken. Scout/coverage-critic request a deep escalation via scripts/escalate-research.js -> `gh workflow run research-agent.yml -f tier=deep` using the job GITHUB_TOKEN, so the dispatched run's actor is github-actions[bot] (type: Bot). anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 rejects bot actors unless listed in allowed_bots, which no step in research-agent.yml sets (the action passes the default allowed_bots=""). Every escalated deep-research run therefore fails at its claude-code-action step with 'Action failed with error: Workflow initiated by non-human actor: github-actions (type: Bot). Add bot to allowed_bots list or use *'. Scheduled 4-hourly runs carry a human actor (CHaerem) and are unaffected — schedule runs Nov 10-11 are all green; only the recall fast-lane is dead. The `gh workflow run` dispatch returns success so escalate-research.js reports success, making the failure invisible except as red research runs.
